rationale.conceptual: The core method—molecular mechanics packing energy minimizations in a specific space group—is an established but non-trivial technique. It requires building a polymer chain with helical symmetry, parameterizing the MM2_85 force field correctly, and performing systematic scans of unit cell axes and chain degrees of freedom. This goes beyond a simple library call and demands understanding of crystallographic symmetry and force field parameterization.
rationale.execution: The workflow consists of five sequential steps with dependencies: (1) building initial crystal structures, (2) packing energy minimizations (scan over a, b, z, ω), (3) fixed-cell coordinate relaxations, and finally (4)–(5) extracting outputs. Setting up LAMMPS with a custom MM2 force field involves non-trivial software configuration, and the parameter sweeps require scripting. This constitutes a moderately complex multi-stage pipeline.
